llm.summary: This planning skill is mostly transparent, but it automatically hands control to an execution skill without asking the user first.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is implementation planning before execution, but the artifact requires auto-invoking `Skill(attune:project-execution)` after saving `docs/implementation-plan.md`, which expands the workflow into implementation activity.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The continuation is disclosed, but the instruction says not to prompt for confirmation; users must know to pass `--standalone` or explicitly request stopping after planning to prevent the handoff.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single markdown skill file with no install script, executable payload, package hook, or hidden runtime component found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Creating a planning document is proportionate for the skill, but automatically entering execution can lead to broader project changes depending on the referenced execution skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background persistence, credential use, privilege escalation, or standalone destructive behavior is present; the main concern is the automatic phase transition.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want this planning workflow to continue into execution by default. If you only want a plan, invoke it with `--standalone` or explicitly tell the agent to stop after creating `docs/implementation-plan.md`.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Supported by the artifact: lines 67-95 require automatic handoff from planning to `attune:project-execution`, which is broader than a planning-only skill.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Supported by the artifact: the skill displays a checkpoint message and then invokes the execution phase, but does not require an explicit user opt-in at that point.
[SQP-3] unexpected: Supported by the artifact: line 88 explicitly says not to prompt the user for confirmation before continuing.
